financial.opportunityDescription: Tightening up margin visibility and recurring revenue is one of the fastest ways to increase business value.
financial.constraintDescription: Unpredictable profit and cash flow make the business harder to value, finance, or sell.
financial.recommendation: Build a monthly cash flow forecast and identify at least one recurring revenue offer.

operations.opportunityDescription: Documenting how the business runs turns tribal knowledge into a transferable asset.
operations.constraintDescription: Without documented systems, quality and output depend on who happens to be in the room.
operations.recommendation: Document your top 3 recurring processes as step-by-step SOPs this quarter.

people.opportunityDescription: Developing a manager who can make real decisions frees the owner from day-to-day firefighting.
people.constraintDescription: Decisions bottleneck through the owner because no one else is empowered to make them.
people.recommendation: Identify one team member to promote into a decision-making leadership role and delegate one full area to them.

market.opportunityDescription: A clearer, defensible position lets the business compete on value instead of price.
market.constraintDescription: Revenue that depends on a few customers or an easily-copied offer is fragile and discounted by buyers.
market.recommendation: Document what makes your offer hard to copy and reduce reliance on your largest customer.

ownerDependence.opportunityDescription: Every relationship and decision that moves off the owner's desk directly increases transferable value.
ownerDependence.constraintDescription: The business is worth less — and harder to sell or scale — if it cannot run without the owner present.
ownerDependence.recommendation: Move one key customer or vendor relationship from yourself to a team member this month.
